# Verywell Health
> Medically reviewed health information covering conditions, symptoms, treatments, medications, nutrition, and wellness.

Verywell Health publishes evidence-based consumer health content reviewed by physicians and other clinicians. Its library spans disease overviews, symptom explainers, drug information, nutrition guidance, mental health, sexual health, and practical care resources.

## Core Health Topics
- [Health A-Z](https://www.verywellhealth.com/health-a-z-4014706): Browse the site’s main index of medical conditions, symptoms, and wellness topics.
- [Symptoms](https://www.verywellhealth.com/symptoms-4014735): Explanations of common symptoms, possible causes, and when to seek care.
- [Conditions A-Z](https://www.verywellhealth.com/conditions-a-z-4014698): Alphabetical directory of diseases, disorders, and chronic health conditions.
- [Treatment](https://www.verywellhealth.com/treatment-4014763): Information on therapies, procedures, recovery, and treatment decision-making.
- [Prevention & Screening](https://www.verywellhealth.com/prevention-and-screening-4014749): Guidance on risk reduction, screening tests, and preventive care.
- [Patient Rights](https://www.verywellhealth.com/patient-rights-4014748): Articles about informed consent, medical records, insurance, and care navigation.

## Drugs, Medications, and Vaccines
- [Drugs A-Z](https://www.verywellhealth.com/drugs-a-z-4014745): Medication library with uses, side effects, interactions, and safety considerations.
- [Drug Safety](https://www.verywellhealth.com/drug-safety-4014744): Guidance on adverse effects, interactions, dosing concerns, and safe medication use.
- [Vaccines](https://www.verywellhealth.com/vaccines-4014765): Vaccine explainers, schedules, effectiveness, and safety information.
- [Tylenol vs. Advil: What's the Difference?](https://www.verywellhealth.com/tylenol-vs-advil-7507804): Comparison of acetaminophen and ibuprofen uses, risks, and dosing considerations.
- [Augmentin vs. Amoxicillin: Which Is Better for Your Infection?](https://www.verywellhealth.com/difference-between-amoxicillin-and-augmentin-4115052): Antibiotic comparison covering indications, differences, and common side effects.
- [Klonopin vs. Valium: How Do They Differ?](https://www.verywellhealth.com/klonopin-vs-valium-how-do-they-differ-8707904): Comparison of benzodiazepines used for anxiety, seizures, and related conditions.

## Nutrition and Wellness
- [Nutrition](https://www.verywellhealth.com/nutrition-4014747): Evidence-based articles on diet, nutrients, eating patterns, and health goals.
- [Vitamins & Supplements](https://www.verywellhealth.com/vitamins-and-supplements-4014764): Information on supplement benefits, risks, interactions, and deficiencies.
- [Hydration](https://www.verywellhealth.com/hydration-7507788): Practical guidance on fluid intake, dehydration, and electrolyte balance.
- [Healthy Aging](https://www.verywellhealth.com/healthy-aging-4014746): Wellness and preventive guidance for older adults and caregivers.
- [I Took Omeprazole: When Can I Drink Coffee?](https://www.verywellhealth.com/i-took-omeprazole-when-can-i-drink-coffee-8584573): Practical guidance on coffee timing while taking omeprazole for reflux.
- [A Pharmacist Explains What Happens When You Mix Caffeine and Alcohol](https://www.verywellhealth.com/caffeine-and-alcohol-11908269): Overview of stimulant-depressant effects, risks, and safety concerns.

## Mental Health and Neurology
- [Mental Health](https://www.verywellhealth.com/mental-health-4014743): Consumer guidance on mood, anxiety, stress, therapy, and psychiatric conditions.
- [Brain & Nervous System](https://www.verywellhealth.com/brain-and-nervous-system-4014738): Articles on neurologic disorders, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment.
- [Sleep Disorders](https://www.verywellhealth.com/sleep-disorders-4014757): Coverage of insomnia, sleep apnea, circadian issues, and related care.
- [Why Obstructive Sleep Apnea Raises Inflammation and Weakens Immune Defenses](https://www.verywellhealth.com/obstructive-sleep-apnea-raises-inflammation-11913427): News-style explainer on sleep apnea’s systemic health effects.
- [PMDD](https://www.verywellhealth.com/pmdd-5207792): Overview of premenstrual dysphoric disorder symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment options.

## Heart, Lung, and Infectious Disease
- [Heart Health](https://www.verywellhealth.com/heart-health-4014741): Information on cardiovascular disease, blood pressure, cholesterol, and prevention.
- [Lung Health](https://www.verywellhealth.com/lung-health-4014742): Coverage of asthma, COPD, infections, breathing symptoms, and respiratory care.
- [Infectious Diseases](https://www.verywellhealth.com/infectious-diseases-4014740): Articles on viral, bacterial, and fungal infections and their treatment.
- [COVID Pneumonia: Symptoms, Risk Factors, Treatment](https://www.verywellhealth.com/pneumonia-and-covid-19-5180252): Overview of COVID-related pneumonia symptoms, risks, and treatment approaches.
- [Paxlovid](https://www.verywellhealth.com/paxlovid-5213681): Consumer guide to COVID-19 antiviral treatment, eligibility, and side effects.
- [Pneumonia](https://www.verywellhealth.com/pneumonia-4014750): General information on pneumonia causes, symptoms, diagnosis, and recovery.

## Digestive, Hormonal, and Reproductive Health
- [Digestive Health](https://www.verywellhealth.com/digestive-health-4014739): Coverage of GERD, IBS, liver disease, bowel symptoms, and digestive disorders.
- [Hormones](https://www.verywellhealth.com/hormones-40147410): Articles on endocrine conditions, hormone changes, and related treatments.
- [Sexual Health](https://www.verywellhealth.com/sexual-health-4014756): Information on sexual wellness, STIs, contraception, and reproductive concerns.
- [Pregnancy](https://www.verywellhealth.com/pregnancy-4014751): Health guidance on pregnancy symptoms, testing, and prenatal care topics.
- [MELD Score](https://www.verywellhealth.com/meld-score-5184998): Explainer on liver disease severity scoring and transplant prioritization.
- [GERD](https://www.verywellhealth.com/gerd-40147411): Overview of reflux symptoms, diagnosis, lifestyle changes, and medications.

## Bones, Joints, and Physical Therapy
- [Bones, Joints, & Muscles](https://www.verywellhealth.com/bones-joints-and-muscles-4014737): Musculoskeletal conditions, injuries, pain, and rehabilitation guidance.
- [Physical Therapy](https://www.verywellhealth.com/physical-therapy-4014752): Exercise-based recovery resources for injuries, pain, and mobility limitations.
- [8 Outer Hip Stretches and Exercises for Low Back Pain](https://www.verywellhealth.com/back-pain-relief-through-outer-hip-muscle-stretching-297195): Step-by-step stretching routine for hip muscles and back pain relief.
- [Physical Therapy Exercises to Treat Runner's Knee](https://www.verywellhealth.com/pt-exercises-for-runners-knee-2696583): Rehab exercises for patellofemoral pain and return to activity.
- [IT Band Syndrome](https://www.verywellhealth.com/iliotibial-band-syndrome-2549384): Overview of iliotibial band pain, causes, and treatment options.
- [ACL Tear](https://www.verywellhealth.com/acl-tear-2548521): Consumer guide to anterior cruciate ligament injury symptoms and recovery.

## News and Expert Perspectives
- [Health News](https://www.verywellhealth.com/news-40147412): Timely reporting on medical studies, public health, and healthcare trends.
- [The Dose](https://www.verywellhealth.com/the-dose-7098145): Newsletter and editorial feature focused on practical health news and context.
- [What to Know About Bird Flu](https://www.verywellhealth.com/bird-flu-7098147): News explainer on avian influenza risks, symptoms, and public health context.
- [Why Cases of Whooping Cough Are Rising](https://www.verywellhealth.com/whooping-cough-cases-rising-8620217): News coverage of pertussis trends, vaccination, and prevention.
- [How Heat Affects Your Medications](https://www.verywellhealth.com/heat-and-medications-8661224): News-style guidance on medication storage and heat-related safety.

- [About Us](https://www.verywellhealth.com/about-us-4158105): Overview of the publication, mission, and audience.

- [Review Board](https://www.verywellhealth.com/review-board-4158108): Information about expert reviewers and their roles in content quality.
- [Diversity Pledge](https://www.verywellhealth.com/diversity-pledge-5082985): Commitment to inclusive, representative, and equitable health coverage.
- [Contact Us](https://www.verywellhealth.com/contact-us-4158109): Contact information for editorial, feedback, and partnership inquiries.
